articles.summary: RLI Corp. (NYSE: RLI) today announced the promotion of four leaders, effective immediately. Kathleen Taylor Promoted to Vice President, Controller Treasurer Kathleen Taylor, Vice President, Accounting and Branch Operations, has been promoted to Vice President, Controller Treasurer. In this expanded role, she will oversee RLI’s Financial Accounting, Reinsurance Accounting, Tax Accounting and Treasury teams. Taylor joined RLI in 2002 as a Reinsurance Administrator and has since held several accounting and operations leadership roles, most recently serving as Vice President, Accounting and Branch Operations. She has 30 years of experience in accounting, finance and insurance. Taylor holds a bachelor’s degree in accounting from Western Illinois University, is a certified public accountant and holds the Chartered Property Casualty Underwriter designation. articles.summary: RLI Corp. (NYSE: RLI) announced today that it will release its third quarter 2026 earnings after market close on Monday, October 19, 2026. The company will hold its quarterly conference call to discuss third quarter results on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. CDT. This call is being webcast by Q4 and can be accessed at https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/320165068 . ABOUT RLI RLI Corp. (NYSE: RLI) is a specialty insurer serving niche property, casualty and surety markets. The company provides deep underwriting expertise and superior service to commercial and personal lines customers nationwide. RLI’s products are offered through its insurance subsidiaries RLI Insurance Company, Mt. Hawley Insurance Company and Contractors Bonding and Insurance Company. All of RLI’s subsidiaries are rated A++ “Superior” by AM Best Company.
